text:
李泽钜*被绑时，李嘉诚不仅全程冷静，一口答应赎金，还在张子强“进门时，带他参观豪宅，确认“家里没有报警”。

张拿到赎金离开时，李嘉诚还与人为善的叫住他，建议他去买自家股票，“保证你们家三代人吃不完”。最后还向张挥手道别。李泽钜被从头到尾好声好气的供着，最后安然回家。

相比之下，郭炳湘太惨了。他不仅被绑匪暴打，还被赤身关在小木箱里六天六夜，大小便都在箱子里解决。
因为当时，他家里先开了个“预算会议”，弟弟们
20亿赎金太高，一直讨价还价，郭炳湘在箱子里受尽折磨，最后还是他的妻子李天颖*单枪匹马拿着赎金救了他。

两个人的后半生也完全不同。李泽钜因为李嘉诚早早规划好了家族接班计划，顺利接手长江实业*，把家族企业发展得风生水起。

而郭炳湘因为对家族失望，变得多疑、偏执，不仅对妻子冷淡疏远，还和兄弟反目成仇，甚至把亲生母亲告上法庭，才分到一些财产。不过，都说龙生龙凤生凤，他在62岁时重新创业，成立了“帝国集团”，主业在内地。

有一个大佬朋友，早年是牛逼闪闪的企业家，现在退出江湖，隐居在美国深宅大院。

后遇见年轻漂亮明眸善睐的现任，又生两子，现在美国陪伴孩子成长，不亦乐乎！

父亲节略有感悟，你想要做一个怎样的父亲？想要成为几个孩子的父亲？

text:
前两天我去医院给我妈拿药，排队的时候碰到一哥们儿。

他手里攥着一沓单子，蹲在挂号大厅地上翻。膝盖上压着 6 张化验报告，3 张处方笺，还有 1 张缴费单。

我问他怎么了。

他说，挂号挂错了。

我说挂错什么。

他说，他爸上周查出来一个指标高，医生让他挂内科，他没听懂，挂成了外科。今天来了，外科大夫说不是我的科室，让他重新挂。

我问他重新挂了没。

他说，挂了。排到 47 号。现在叫到 23 号。

我说那不就等着呗。

他说，他等了 40 分钟，发现他挂的是下午的号。

我问他上午为啥不挂上午的。

他说，他以为上午去就是上午的号。

我当场没忍住笑了。他也笑。

他说，兄弟你别笑我，我这辈子第一次自己来医院。我妈以前啥都管，我连挂号机都没碰过。

我说你妈呢。

他说，我妈上个月摔了，股骨头骨折，住院了。

他蹲在那里的姿势一直没变，6 张化验报告被风吹得哗哗响。他也没压住。

我陪他重新跑了一遍。先去服务台问清楚挂哪个科，再用医保卡在机器上挂号。机器上那个科室名字写了 11 个字，他看了 3 遍才找到。

挂号单出来的时候，他看了一下那个号码，说，37 号。

我说，37 号比 47 号早。

他说，是哦。

他说完这句话就转身往候诊区走，走了两步又回头说，兄弟，谢了。

我说没事。

他走远之后我站在那里想，我们这代人，被父母包办了一切。结婚父母包办，买房父母凑首付，生孩子父母带，连去医院都是父母带。

突然有一天父母病了，进医院了，我们才发现，连个号都不会挂。

我蹲在挂号大厅地上，又看到了几个跟我差不多年纪的人，有的在打电话问人挂哪个科，有的拿着手机看挂号教程。

币圈有句老话，叫币圈一天，人间一年。

意思是市场变化太快，人会一夜之间被迫长大。

其实医院也一样。

父母在的时候，你永远是孩子。父母病了那一刻，你就一夜长大了。

你最近一次被迫长大，是什么事？

明天就是结婚五周年纪念日了。
晚上躺在床上，丈夫搂着妻子温柔地问：“老婆，明天的礼物想要什么？
给你个提示，我已经准备好了，
是一个能在短短几秒钟内
从0飙升到100，能让你心跳加速、
血压升高，并且伴随剧烈震动的东西。你绝对会每天都想
骑在上面体验那种刺激感。”
妻子一听，激动得从床上坐了起来，
脑海中立刻浮现出红色的法拉利跑车，或者是某种难以启齿
但极其昂贵的成人高级玩具。
她红着脸，娇嗔地捶了丈夫一下：
“讨厌啦，你这就把我拿捏了？
到底是什么神仙宝贝？”
第二天早上，妻子满怀期待地
拉开客厅的红布，只见一台硕大的、
最高脱水转速1200转的
全自动滚筒洗衣机赫然立在眼前。
丈夫笑着说：“你不是嫌手洗衣服累吗？这脱水时的震动感，绝对震撼！”
😂😂😂

text:
时间线上有大量的智谱glm5.2 的讨论，结合最近跟几个投资方聊天，他们给出的观点非常粗暴，

说个有意思的事，国内 AI 应用软件，在市场上是没人愿意投的，原因很简单，大模型们版本迭代，就可能把一个细分领域的 AI软件内化迭代，甚至是一个 skill 就能搞定你几十人的团队的产品，靠信息差挣点小钱还行，靠资本基本上没戏了。

说回，GLM-5.2，它不是新模型，而是同一模型家族的优化版本。想象一下：GLM-5.1是一辆标准版汽车，GLM-5.2是同一辆车但调校了发动机和变速箱，让它跑得更快更省油，但底盘和车身没变。性能提升来自强化学习（让模型在试错中学习）和训练后优化（微调模型输出），而不是堆更多参数。结果是：成本基本不变，但输出质量更高，客户愿意为更好的任务完成率、更少的重试、更高价值的用例（编码、代理、企业工作流自动化、长上下文任务）支付更多。

我看讨论最少但是最需要理清的一件事，到底 glm 是国产芯片训练还是靠美国芯片？

4 个月前，昇腾0day支持智谱GLM-5，744B模型单机高效推理，GLM 5.2 Day0，也是完成全系列国产算力芯片适配，这里有没有英伟达芯片参与的水分，必然是有的，但是整体是国产配比更高一些。

将于8月发布GLM-5.5 大模型，可能还会颠覆中国大模型在世界的影响力，可能是>1T参数模型。

摩根大通将智谱AI目标价从1400港元上调至1800港元，维持增持评级。基于30倍2030年市盈率，15% WACC折现。

• 美国代表团比伊朗代表团早得多就进入了会场。在外交中，掌握筹码的一方不会在房间里等待。你们声称自己领先且胜券在握，却先到了。这是第一个错误。

• 加利巴夫没有在媒体入场时进入，而JD·万斯进入了。这是另一个错误。这看起来不仅像是抛弃了包括以色列在内的盟友，还因为无视基本的外交礼仪而损害了美国的形象。

Después de haber visto estos dos partidos, Musiala y Wirtz no pueden jugar juntos. O al menos no pueden jugar en este esquema. Ninguno de los dos siente la banda. El lugar de ambos está en el centro del ataque.

Entiendo que por la dinámica que tienen, uno puede pensar en poner a Florian por izquierda, pero ayer demostró que no siente el puesto, que no se encuentra. 

Nagelsmann deberá elegir y, hasta acá, Musiala estuvo mejor.

😂😀✌️

万斯抵达瑞士，与谈判调解方巴基斯坦领导人见面。

万斯这样说：

“我曾开玩笑说过，我生命中最重要的两个人是，一个印度人和一个巴基斯坦人。

印度人是我的妻子，巴基斯坦人是您，穆尼尔陆军元帅。”

……

川普也在瑞士，川普听了这话后不知道高不高兴。😂😂😂

quotedTweet.text:
伊朗人根本不怕川普的威胁了，怎么办？

😂😂😂😀😀😀

福克斯新闻报道，川普在瑞士威胁伊朗官员，如果他们在内塔尼亚胡轰炸黎巴嫩时关闭霍尔木兹海峡，他们就回不了伊朗。

川普告訴福克斯新闻记者，说他与伊朗官员交谈，并告诉他们，“你们关闭霍尔木兹海峡，你们就没国家了。”

川普说：“你们甚至回不了你们那该死的国家。”

……

但伊朗还是在昨天毅然决然的关闭了霍尔木兹海峡。😂😂😂

现在的川普，国内太多人在骂他，以色列不会放过他，伊朗人瞧不起他……

哎。只有我们这些真心为他好的爱国者，当初苦口婆心请他不要上当不要轻易打伊朗。却被他和他的死忠们骂成了叛徒。哈哈哈。

川普的苦日子还在后面。

一旦民主党上台，就会跟他算总账。

打伊朗，将成为川普政治生涯的滑铁卢，其后果严重性怎么说都不为过。

想起来，无限唏嘘。

端午节听朋友说，曾任济南市委常委、副市长的徐群（正厅级）在南方闯荡了几年后，回到济南的一家中小规模的民营企业上班了，成为了和大家一样的打工牛马。
徐群曾经是山东省最年轻的正厅级干部之一，2019年，在王忠林办公室汇报工作时，因办事不力，被火爆的忠林书记打了一巴掌。被打后不堪受辱，辞职下海。
下海后，他过得不如之前风光，很多人认为他不应该因为扇耳光就辞职，但在我看来，在纪委高强度反腐的背景下，辞职下海可能反而让自己有了一个好的结局。

1950年世界杯因为路途遥远，交通费贵，不少球队直接放弃参加。

那个年代，跨洲参加一场体育比赛，是一件极其费时、费钱、路途遥远的事情。

当年亚洲球队如果要去巴西踢世界杯，坐船可能要漂几个星期；就算坐飞机，也不是今天这种十几个小时直达，而是要多次中转，时间、费用和后勤压力都非常大。

1950年巴西世界杯，当时亚洲区原本有缅甸、菲律宾、印尼、印度争一个名额，结果前三队主动退赛，印度躺着拿到资格，最后自己也没去。

text:
Karpathy 说了一句反常识的话：用自然语言写 prompt 让 AI 写代码，其实效率很低。

他的做法是直接把光标移到要改的位置，敲前3个字母，让模型自动补全。光标位置+上下文代码+前几个字符，信息密度比你打一段英文描述高得多。

他把 AI 编程分了三档：完全不用（过时了）、vibe coding 全交给 AI（大部分场景不靠谱）、自己当架构师 AI 当补全工具（他选这个）。

为什么不信 vibe coding？他拿自己的项目举了个例子：8张GPU同步梯度他没用标准的 DDP，自己写了一套。AI 反复逼他改回 DDP，完全理解不了为什么有人不用标准方案。

模型的问题不是不够聪明，是"记忆太多"。训练数据里全是标准写法，你一写非标准的东西它就懵了，还会偷偷把你的代码往"常见写法"上改。

text:
我把AI未来3年的核心瓶颈排了个序，大概是这样：

1. 存储（HBM + DRAM + eSSD，已经涨价、签长单、利润兑现）
2. 光互连（800G / 1.6T + Scale-Up + Scale-Across，连接接棒算力）
3. 先进封装（CoWoS + CoPoS + HBM封装，HBM和GPU放量的前提）
4. ASIC + Networking（自研芯片、交换芯片、SerDes、DSP，MRVL/AVGO核心位置）
5. 电力 / AI Factory（变压器、电网、UPS、800V DC、BBU，并网容量是真瓶颈）
6. 液冷（DLC、CDU、冷板，高功率机柜必选项）
7. 核能 / 发电（长期空间巨大，但兑现节奏慢于电力设备）
8. PCB / ABF / CCL（AI服务器和先进封装配套材料，真实受益但控制力弱于前面）
9. MLCC / 被动元件（高频高压高功率带来用量提升，属于配套瓶颈）
10. 半导体设备（检测、量测、测试、先进封装设备，卖水给淘金者）
11. Physical AI（机器人、自动驾驶、工业AI，空间大但2026仍偏预期）
12. Agent / 数据层（方向确定，但赢家和利润分配还不清晰）
13. 稳定币 / AI金融（AI Agent支付层，空间大但商业化还早）

未来三年市场会越来越关注：谁是真瓶颈，谁能把瓶颈兑现成利润，谁控制下一代架构。
我目前最看好的，还是存储第一，光互连第二，先进封装第三。因为AI发展到最后，拼的是谁真正卡住了整个产业链的命脉。

Mythos 被禁用的更多内幕被爆出来：
Mythos在几个小时内就攻破了美国国家安全局（ NSA）的所有机密系统

这个性能太逆天了！

不是 Mythos 偷偷黑了NSA，而是NSA在内部测试中，用这个模型模拟攻击自己的系统，结果Mythos 表现太猛，几小时就搞定了大部分机密网络。

参议院情报委员会副主席马克·华纳（Mark Warner）表示，在6月11日，领导国家安全局和五角大楼网络司令部的约书亚·鲁德将军（General Joshua Rudd）向他透露，“Mythos不仅在数周内，而且在数小时内就几乎攻破了我们所有的机密系统”。

消息来源：《经济学人》

美媒爆料：经过24小时的激烈博弈，Fable 5 和 Mythos 5被禁用

模型发布前，美国政府曾经要求 Anthropic 暂时不要发布，但没有成功，两个模型仍然发布出来。

模型发布后，亚马逊Amazon CEO Andy Jassy 向白宫反映 jailbreak 问题（越狱）。美国政府以此为借口，要求 Anthropic 禁止外国用户使用。
Anthropic选择直接禁止所有用户使用，包括美国用户。

24小时完整时间线👇

周四（模型公开发布后两天）：
Amazon CEO Andy Jassy 向白宫反映 jailbreak 问题（Amazon 是 Anthropic 大投资方，应政府请求提供反馈）。

周五上午：
白宫高层紧急会议，参与者包括：财政部长 Scott Bessent 、白宫国家网络总监 Sean Cairncross、白宫办公厅主任 Susie Wiles 等。

周五中午前后：
白宫尝试联系 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei，他当时“外出”（Anthropic 否认是 wellness retreat）。

周五下午1点后：
Dario 参与三通紧张电话，对方阵容强大：Cairncross、Bessent、商务部长 Howard Lutnick  
其他官员：Jeffrey Kessler、Will Scharf、Richard Walters、Walker Barrett 等。

周五傍晚（美东时间5:21 PM）：
政府正式下达出口管制指令。
Anthropic 因无法仅屏蔽外国用户，只能全局禁用模型。

这件事的本质，是政府面对AI的快速发展，应该怎么监管。
估计美国政府对于AI的监管文件很快就要出来了。

text:
日本4:0大胜突尼斯之后，伊布拉西莫维奇说：

“人们不该再把日本称为‘黑马’了。一支球队如果能一而再、再而三地踢出这样的比赛，那它就不是什么意外惊喜，而是真正具备争冠实力的球队。

能在世界杯上 4 比 0 大胜绝不是稀松平常的事。没有哪支球队会靠运气把对手打成这样。你之所以能做到，是因为你拥有实力、体系、自信，以及一群知道自己在场上该做什么的球员。

最让我印象深刻的是他们的踢法。他们毫无畏惧、毫不犹豫，也不把对手的名气放在眼里。他们以极高的强度进攻，整体协防，让每一个对手都踢得极其难受。

世界杯开赛前，所有人都在谈论那些传统豪门。但一场接一场比赛下来，日本正在用自己的表现，硬生生把自己挤进争冠热门的行列。

如果我是那些传统强队中的一员，看完这场比赛，我会感到担忧，非常担忧。因为日本队看起来每打一场都在进步。

更可怕的是，他们似乎还不满足。即使已经 3 比 0、4 比 0 领先，他们依然在持续高位逼抢、持续奔跑、持续寻找下一个进球。这是一支真正相信自己能够创造历史的球队才会有的心态。

你可以拥有全世界最耀眼的球星，但如果碰上一支纪律严明、充满自信、整体运转如此出色的球队，你一定会踢得非常痛苦。

此时此刻，日本队正在一步步成为本届世界杯的夺冠热门之一。也许有些人不愿意承认，但足球从来不看名气，更不看历史，它只看场上的表现。

相信我，下一轮无论谁抽到日本，都绝不会暗自庆幸。他们脑子里想的，只会是：我们到底该怎么对付这支球队？

Girl at the bar last night asked me how old I thought she was.

She looked late 20s/early 30s.

I said “I don’t know… 44?”

The look on her face was like I just told her her dog died.

She was 31.

Spent the next 20 minutes explaining why everyone else usually guesses younger.

Oddly enough, she became way more interested in me after that.

读书笔记：

中国国内有位学者苏德超，设计过一个思想实验：给你两种人生，第一种是，你活了100岁，上学读书，娶妻生子，拿到诺贝尔奖，最后寿终正寝。第二种人生是，你只能活100天，但你也结了婚生了孩子，还拿到了诺贝尔奖。你愿意过哪种人生？

他解释说，大部分人肯定都是选100岁的人生。他问这个问题的目的就是希望大家重新认识到：

体验、对我们每个人的生命来说才是最重要的，而不是知识，不是力量，也不是社会地位。

—《三联生活周刊》2025年第44期，第43页

text:
在故乡的夜色里，我常常想起那些沉默的老人。

儿女有了出息，远走异国，便等于不曾生养；去了大都会，也只剩半个；唯有留在身边的，虽穷困些，却还算有个依靠。这话初听极端，细想却如一把钝刀，慢慢割进心底，叫人久久不能言语。

世人总以为，孩子越聪明、越有本事，自己晚景便越安乐。殊不知，越是优秀的苗子，越发长得远。出了国的，隔着时差与重洋；进了城的，被事务所与生计牢牢缚住；只有那不争气的，才真正在生活里陪着你。如此一来，世上便出现了一桩极荒谬的景象：儿女越有出息，父母越发孤单。

这原是极现实的道理。人到后半生，所求便变了。少年时要的是天地，要的是前程；到得垂暮，所要的不过是——有人能说说话，有人能在病榻边递一口水，有人能在半夜惊醒时，推门进来点一盏灯。

钱能买来药，却买不来那守在走廊里的身影；电话能传声，却填不满屋子里那一片死寂。一个人在医院的长椅上枯坐，与有人陪着，是两样完全不同的人生。

前些时，网上流传一张“A4纸人生”。把七十五年折成九百个月，若一年只见父母一面，剩下的光阴便只剩薄薄十几格。白纸黑线，看似轻飘飘，细看却叫人胸口发闷。

我们一生都在奔走，奔向更远、更亮堂的地方，以为那是“更好”。却不曾留意：我们每向前一步，父母便向孤独深处退一步。我们走得越远，他们的日子便越窄，越冷。

所以，诸位在外漂泊的，若还有一丝空闲，便打一个电话吧；若还有一口气力，便发一段视频吧；若还有可能，便多回几次家，哪怕只坐一坐，陪他们晒晒太阳，说几句闲话。

人生固然漫长，可真正能陪父母的光阴，其实少得可怜。待到只剩一抔黄土、一缕回忆时，才忽然醒悟：原来那最该走的一段路，我们竟缺席了。

这世间，最锋利的不是刀，而是迟来的悔。

text:
草台班子伤透了谢里夫的心。

今天，瑞士布根施托克湖畔的豪华会场，本该是美伊和解的希望之地，却上演了一出让世界瞠目结舌的戏剧。巴基斯坦总理米安·穆罕默德·夏巴兹·谢里夫站在那里，目送伊朗代表团因川普的威胁而愤怒离场。那一刻，他脸上错愕、失望乃至近乎绝望的神情，全部写在了脸上。 

世界记住了这个时刻：一个职业老练政治家的无奈。

谢里夫不是新人。他1951年生于拉合尔，出身政治和商业世家，是前总理纳瓦兹·谢里夫的弟弟。从上世纪80年代步入政坛，三度出任旁遮普省首席部长，以务实治理和基础设施建设闻名。2022年和2024年两度担任巴基斯坦总理，他早已习惯了大国博弈的风云变幻。 

然而，今天的瑞士，他还是被“伤透了心”。
过去几个月，巴基斯坦为推动美伊谈判付出了巨大努力：穿梭外交、多国协调、伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录（Islamabad MoU）的签署……作为主要调解方之一，谢里夫和他的团队尽心尽力，希望通过对话结束冲突、重开霍尔木兹海峡、稳定地区局势。

然而，当今天伊朗代表团在进入会场时，只与谢里夫热情拥抱，却拒绝与美方团队握手拍照，这已经透露出紧张气氛。 

当川普在社交媒体和福克斯新闻上的强硬表态——威胁轰炸伊朗、占领霍尔木兹海峡、甚至暗示伊朗代表团“回不了国”——直接点燃了导火索。伊朗代表团在会谈仅进行80分钟左右后愤然离场，谈判陷入僵局。 

谢里夫那张写满失望的脸，成为了今天外交场上最真实的写照。

当今这个世界，强权可以随意凌辱他人，国际规则如同儿戏，国与国乃至人与人之间的交往早就失去了应有的体面和尊重。

这可能是谢里夫职业生涯最尴尬的时刻，但绝对不会是最后一次。

因为这个世界已经变成了巨大的草台班子。

I used to be a die-hard Claude Code user.

Codex has won me over because:

→ GPT-5.5 is excellent
→ Fast mode + generous limits = more reps
→ Little touches like steering, auto remote control on phone, etc

But most of all Codex's browser and computer use capabilities are simply goated. I built so many workflows relying on those two things alone instead of hunting for APIs.

I still use Claude Code too. The app seems to be getting better and the design and frontend capability of Opus is still much better than GPT. Whenever Fable comes back that's another reason to go back.

Honestly, I hope these two compete forever and other players (Cursor/Grok, Gemini, etc) all stay competitive.

This way the builder keeps winning 🙂

地球的最优人口其实只有25亿，但全球人口已超80亿。当印度、巴基斯坦、尼日利亚等国人口严重超载，爆发饥荒与高温时，大规模的移民潮就变成了一场无声的战争。

大批外来移民正在疯狂挤占英、美、加、澳以及中国香港等地的生存资源，导致这些发达地区的生活水平肉眼可见地倒退。这本质上是一场零和博弈：多一个移民，就可能挤死一个当地人。所有国家迟早要面临选择——让自己的国民死，还是让移民死？

西方之所以出现这种悲剧，核心在于选票政治——政客为了选票去收买、优待移民。如果不加以控制，未来全球必然集体右转，甚至会重现集中营和强制遣返等极端手段。

对于中国来说，最明智的策略就是严防死守，绝不接受任何移民。

同时，最有效的防御手段就是彻底切断选票绑架：

只发劳工签证：对特定高风险地区的移民永远不给国籍，只发一年一签、可随时驱逐的劳工签证，不给任何政治权利。
取消政治资格：即使已入籍的特定族裔，也必须剥夺其选举与任职资格。

只要移民没有了选票价值，政客就不会放任其涌入。在残酷的生存资源争夺战面前，守住边界，才是对自己国民最大的负责。

一个普通白领家庭的小孩，大学毕业找不到工作，问父母要 15 万全部买 QQQ，接着在家里躺到 60 岁，也财务自由了。

大部分人做不到是因为急功近利，看的是短期涨跌，而非数十年的回报。

text:
我说实话，哈工大院士班出来以后，对于绝大多数高考600分（赋分制省份640分）以上的学生来说，绝对是致命一击。

就是说，在中国目前的学制下，7年才能本科+硕士毕业，11年才能本硕博毕业，

然而哈工大院士班的同学，6年直接本硕博全部拿到，直接毕业，AI、航院控制自动化、电子、材料四选一，

这种事情大概相当于，你天天37度上晚自习，你一毕业了，学校装了空调，并且晚自习人人免费酸梅汤、免费炸鸡腿无限供应。

直接成了他妈时代的眼泪了。

哪怕是清华大学的毕业生，你回忆你和你们班劝退专业傻逼们一起卷了整整4年GPA，考托福，考GRE，录取美国名校PhD，五年完成qualify，发paper，做一两期postdoc，完完全全在浪费人生。

再看哈工大院士班，哪怕是GPA垫底25%，也能6年材料博士毕业，也能直接躺进宁德时代拿年薪80万（对，宁德时代给new grad PhD尤其是target school就是这个数字），

完完全全不低于字节和智谱、moonshot这个档次的7年制本硕毕业的工资。

我说实话，哈工大当年4系无数人，是贴着清华分数线考进来的，4系航院自动化到今天都是哈工大第一王牌专业，压久负盛名中国NLP小斯坦福的哈工大3系计算机一头，

然而我们班同学们今天回忆这件事，一定是又高兴又怅然若失。

现在的孩子们是真幸运，迎来了哈工大院士班这种6年制本博连读，这就是他妈的时代，这就是他妈的未来可期。

text: just quick retraction of my (deleted) post that I've not been using AI. after being traumatized by GPT 5.5 fucking up, Fable being withdrawn, and Opus 4.8 being depressingly dumb (relatively), I spent some days coding manually and I made a lot of progress. that said, I over-compensated. pure manual coding is not faster than using AI. it is faster than using AI poorly. like everything, there is a balance where you use it responsibly: audits, well specified refactors, sanity checks... where you can extract a lot of value. my mistake was letting codex edit a lot of code unsupervised without really reading its output. that's clearly my own fault for using it poorly and Bend's delay is attributable to it. it is a new powerful tech. I think not using it is a mistake, but using it too aggressively is a mistake too. I've been using AI carefully and doing things way slower now, taking the time needed to assert each added functionality is correct, well written, and well understood, before moving to the next, and, by doing so, things are actually moving faster, because progress only moves forward, never backward - which happens a lot when you let AI unsupervised. I'm halfway through. Bend2 has 50% of the pre-rewrite features, except the code is now beautiful and extremely robust. this is not adding anything it didn't have, I'm just ensuring the codebase mets my own quality standards

text:
和国内某头部模型公司朋友聊了下，GLM本轮迭代冲击对整个行业是巨大的

它用极致压缩的时间追赶上了顶尖大模型。GLM-5/5.1 标注其综合能力对标Claude Opus 4.6，技术路线明确从零散试错编码转向标准化Agent工程。

以往行业靠算力、数据、强化学习可维持数月到一年的领先，现在的优势周期仅剩数周。那么未来，用户能够感知到的模型差距就会被抹平，用户评判只看代码能力、任务稳定性、价格三点，不在乎榜单与训练细节。

GLM证明模型性能只是易追赶的工程成果，无法形成永久壁垒。

市场需要重新厘清四个关键问题：

1. 模型企业高估值的长期支撑是什么？

2. 算力投入能否形成可持续壁垒？

3. 开源追平闭源后，闭源服务如何保住溢价？

4. 模型无明显差距时，企业核心盈利路径在哪？

未来竞争重心不再是堆更强基础模型，而是掌握用户入口、落地真实场景、实现稳定变现。

真正的隐患不在于模型变强，而是迭代速度超出预期——市场意识到，单纯的基础大模型，远没有炒作中价值那么高。

那么距离 AI 的泡沫破灭还剩多久？Anthropic 的高估值还能维持多久？

英语国家的居民里，投资美股税负最重的是🇦🇺澳大利亚。

在澳大利亚，资本利得并入个人普通所得，按累进边际税率征收（最高档 45%，再加 2% 的 Medicare 税，合计 47%）。

持有超过一年的资产可享受 50% 折扣。折扣后，中高收入者的实际税率大致落在 16%–23.5% 区间，平均约 20% 左右；若持有不满一年、无法享受折扣，高收入者的税负最高可逼近 47%。

无论从平均还是峰值看，都是英语国家中最重的之一。

比如一个人投美股赚了 10 万美元，持有超过一年的高收入者，折扣后实际缴税约 2.35 万美元；若持有不满一年，最高需缴约 4.7 万美元。

text:
Vale’s GET’R DONE Master Plan 🚀

In 1997 Amazon was “just” an online bookstore.

Today Vale Concepts is Seattle’s fastest-growing modern matcha brand.

Our goal for the next five years is clear: become the market leader in matcha across the United States and beyond. I have strong conviction we will get there.
In 10 years, people will look back and say: “Wasn’t Vale that matcha company?”

Some might look to AI for their strategy I have a simpler muse. Mater from Pixar's Cars.

Our Master Plan is GET’R DONE:

GENESIS
The idea has lived with me since the mid-90s watching Microsoft, Starbucks, and Amazon scale in the Pacific Northwest. In 2014 I emailed my pal Tyler Conant and sketched out a plan to build an automated, app-pay beverage machine. 

EXECUTION
Phase 1 (2025–2026): Build a deeply loved brand delivering amazing crafted cold drinks. Prove out an automated experience. We want to shatter people's expectations for what can come out of a machine. 
Phase 2 (2027–2029): Refine and simplify automation and scale intelligent machines.
Phase 3 (2030+): Land and expand. City by city, country by country, category by category.

TRANSFORMATION
Move beyond drinks into broader daily essentials. People don’t want more pre-packaged crap. They want crafted food & beverage that actually tastes good delivered with radical accessibility and convenience.

REVOLUTION
Archaic zoning laws are broken. Why is mixed retail and residential impossible? My old boss Rick Smith had to go to war with Scottsdale to build housing close to his HQ and put some amenities there. Why should 90% of Americans have to drive 2.5+ miles for a decent café or restaurant?

We’re going to attack those outdated rules head-on. Push boundaries. Reimagine zoning. Put Vale machines on every corner real neighborhood fuel, crafted fresh, available 24/7.

This isn’t just a beverage company. This is smart infrastructure for better neighborhoods. Unmanned automated retail will happen. Vale is going to make it awesome and not suck. 

I say we're going to have 1 million machines by 2040. I think that is a low ball estimate. I think it will be 10x that.

As for Adam Schiff, I will have to think long and hard about who would be a good match to play this treasonous, extraterrestrial pencil-neck, bug-eyed freak.

As for Roger Stone, I will personally make a cameo appearance, because the film needs to have at least some level of truth to it. Even Castro-lover Sean Penn—who dresses like shit and thinks he’s James Dean—would agree.

🏴‍☠️Why does a 30-year-old pirate movie matter?

Because "Cutthroat Island" is a reminder that building something great isn't enough.

The filmmakers spent nearly $100 million creating an incredible spectacle. Real ships. Real stunts. Real explosions. Massive practical action sequences.

But audiences never showed up.

Not because the production wasn't impressive.
Because they were never convinced it was an event they couldn't miss.

That's a lesson that extends far beyond Hollywood.

I've seen talented creators, businesses, podcasts, YouTube channels, products, and startups make the same mistake.

They pour everything into creating.

And almost nothing into distribution. 

They assume quality alone will be discovered.

It won't.

The hard truth is that the best product doesn't always win.

The best marketed product usually does.

You can build something remarkable.
But if nobody knows why it matters...

Nobody shows up.

That's the real lesson of Cutthroat Island.

text:
A Father’s Day message to all the dads out there: 

Each and every time you hear your child audibly say the word “dad” is a gift of immeasurable value. 

Their voices will shift and change, they’ll say it less often, and each and every time is a snowflake, perfect, unique, fleeting. 

Every time you hear your child say “dad” try to take a beat.  Take a breath. Hear it. Smile inside. You made that. You earn that. Not “earned”, you “earn” that. Every minute of every day. It never stops.

When you have young kids everything moves so fast. So many logistics, places to be, the drumbeat never stops. It’s hard to be present when there’s so much to do.

My kids are thriving almost 21 year old twins. I have great relationships with each of them, but I hear the word “dad” less than ever before. They’re busy having truly joyful college experiences. 

It used to be dozens of times a day. Now it’s a few times month when they actually just say the word.

So now each and every time I hear it I’m trying to take a beat. Take a breath. Smile inside.

If I could go back in time I’d love to have tried to be more present. Find ways to tale breath. To feel the million moments more deeply.

Every time you hear the word “dad” spoken out loud by your child, take a moment for yourself. 

You earn it.

Happy Father’s Day to all the dads out there.❤️

text:
Long message and just how I am feel so it’s the warning 😂.

Hey everyone how are you all doing? I want to get my feelings thoughts out tonight so I can concentrate on my birthday next weekend.

First off it is crazy I am going to be 40 on Saturday. I really never thought I would make it to that age with how life has been. It has been one rollercoaster that is for sure. I want to say to you all if you have a family that you have a relationship with please cherish it, hold on to it and make as many memories as you can. Do not regret that you had the opportunity to make them.

You all know that I have no relationship with mine and it is sad to know I will not have any birthday cards or anything from my blood relatives. I am excited that this is going to be my first birthday party even though it is just me on a pc, but at least it will be with people who want to be around me. I do really have to say thank you to Sakura for taking me off the street and becoming the sister I didn’t have.

With my growing up and I have said stuff about this but there is so much I haven’t said about things that happened and that I deal with the respective services. I always kinda thought I would have had my life ended with it.

Did you know I went nearly a year in school not talking to anyone except teachers 😂. The health might be crap and I might be stuck at home now most of the time but I am actually ok with it all.

Most people wouldn’t be standing here today with what I have been through and I really mean that. The stuff I went through would have destroyed so many and I can look at people and say that. We are all strong for different reasons.

With this all I can say is that I am so proud of myself for where I am today, I might now have money, I might not have an irl family, I might of grown up alone with no friends, I might be unwell but do you know what? I am still here. I have never given up which would be the much easier thing.

So there are people now who will talk to me know and message me to see if I am ok. It is a nice feeling and a nice change. I am thankful to be breathing and be able to do something.

I became a vtuber to achieve something in life and not just waste away in the corner, to meet people, to make friends and make a family. Zentreya gave me a belief that you can go through a lot in life but still stand up, still try and make a difference and I am forever grateful for that. My goal now is well known, I want to be able to earn enough money to keep a house over my head and not be homeless again, make friends and prove to myself I am worth something, to become a mutual friend of Zentreya. To get to know her and become a person she can trust and someone I can trust. Nothing more just a friendship and I am so proud to be a member of her community.

I am sad that I won’t achieve my personal goal of getting that opportunity before this birthday I have on Saturday. I have never been told no and nothing mean maybe in the future.

I think the deep thing is that I am proud that I am trying. I try and fight everyday when it would be easier to feel sorry for myself and just let in consume me. So I am proud that I am me. I will continue to spread the positivity I try to spread on a daily basis, even if I had had the piss taken out of me.

I will try to get my dream/goal until I am told no.i will continue to be a person who hasn’t shut their DM’s for people needing to talk. I am proud of who I am and I am proud to be alive. Never give up any of you.

I say this and I do mean it when I say I love you all that have given me a chance. You are all amazing and you should all be so proud to still be here today.

🖤💚

text:
Two underrated pieces supercharge my mobile dev workflow: @openclaw message and ntfy.

I run them with Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, long-running scripts, and whatever random agents I've got going, so they can reach me when work finishes or when they need a call from me. 

Goal completions, scheduled jobs, overnight runs, the stuff that used to mean checking back in every 30 minutes now just pings me when there's something worth my attention or there's a result to review.

The 'openclaw message' command gives anything I run a direct line to WhatsApp. Just a plain send-message command that hits the WhatsApp channel without hitting the OpenClaw agent instance itself. If I've got my Ray-Bans on, the notification plays there too.

ntfy handles the fast push/action side. Those notifications can carry links to my own local URLs (all my local projects on a .lab domain) that already work across my devices over Tailscale. So I tap the push and land right in the running app, report, dashboard, or approval screen.

They can carry buttons too, which is perfect for agents that just need a quick yes/no/approve/retry without dragging me into a full chat session.

Most of the time I just fire off both. WhatsApp catches me where I already am. ntfy gives me the tap-through when I actually want to act.

text: A data center is a black box. Power and capital go in. Tokens come out, along with a bunch of crap (CO2, heat, water consumption, and other externalities). Anything you improve inside that black box, whether cooling, power distribution, silicon, or networking, ultimately affects token output. The question is just by how much. Tokens are directly tied to data center revenue, and that is what operators actually care about. So instead of expressing benefits in thermal metrics, we express them in terms of how much more token output the same power and capital can produce. In our case, we also eliminate water and reduce the other crap along the way. Tokens per watt (and tokens per dollar of capex) is increasingly the metric everyone benchmarks on. It is the only one that maps directly to revenue and ROI.

text:
Happy Father’s Day Month!!

Sinclair does not know it’s Father’s Day. He just got back from work and it eager to re-heat the brisket from yesterday and have himself a brisket sandwich. As he sits down awaiting the all-done beep from the microwave a gift slides in front of him in the midst of processing what just slid in front of him he’s overtaken by his whole family and kissed on both cheeks by his children and feels his wife’s hands in his hair. 
“Happy Father’s Day!” He hears causing him to have a flashback to the very moments he and Sylvia adopted Gilda and Martin. Seeing their eyes go from
Curious to loving to finally hear them say Papa for the first time. 
All the wonderful moments he spent with his children are forever treasured in his heart. Painting Gilda’s nails, teaching Martin how change the oil, brushing Gilda’s hair, and picking the right scarf Martin all his favorite moments.
  He’s glad Sylvia and Him made the decision to adopt them. He’s happy he’s their Father and he’s Loves them so much. And to be reminded today how much his family Loves is wonderful.

It is by sheer luck today that Serena happened to open the calendar on her phone and see it’s Father’s Day! Instantly she calls Adaline so the both of them can do something nice for a Important Man in their lives. Petey. Adaline’s Father and Serena’s Brother. Both figure he doesn’t know what day it is today so it will be perfect opportunity to surprise him and more importantly it will be the only Father’s Day Adaline will ever celebrate while in her Human form so this has to be perfect for Petey. 
Petey at Adaline’s request goes out to buy some cherry cola giving Serena and Adaline ample to prepare everything. Upon getting back Adaline launches herself into his arms wishing him a wonderful Father’s Day! “I love you so much Father!” Adaline declares as she sits Father down on the table to prepare him for the food that shall be served to
Him. Petey is speechless, he doesn’t know how to respond nor know how to accept this is his first ever Father’s Day. All he can do is smile knowing Adaline and Serena did this for him. To feel his Daughter’s cheek against his as she hugs is greatest feeling in the world. 

Absolute thanks to @garyu410 and @Nihu77 for these beautiful Father’s Day art works. I love them so much.

June 22, 2026


Father’s Day is just a brief spotlight on a love that lives quietly in the shadows every other day of the year.


Fatherhood spans far beyond the confines of a twenty-four-hour calendar day. The necessity for a designated "Father's Day" serves not to contain love, but simply to pause our rushing world, serving as a quiet altar for gratitude amidst the endless currents of time.

A father’s love doesn't tick away like the hours of a clock; it is the silent, ongoing architecture of a life. It lives in the calloused hands, the steady voice of reason, and the enduring principles passed down through generations.


~ Aasi Tahir Siddique
